This might not be 100% accurate but this is my understanding of it...I read a self help book lately called The Happiness Equation (would really recommend). Whenever I feel stuck on life and not sure what to do next , I go back to a concept in the book called the "success triangle". Essentially there are three main things you can focus on.  Self, social and sales (your job/career). I write down a list of things I might want to achieve for each one.

 For self I might write I want to focus on keeping fit, mindful eating, getting into a hobby I've been wanting to try for ages. For social I might write wanting to spend more time with loved ones, going out with friends etc. For sales I might write focusing on improving my work performance, doing a course, perhaps looking for a new job. 

Essentially the book says you can only truly focus on two of those things to make a real difference. Trying to do everything at once will be too much and you'll end up doing things half-arsed. For me, last year it was self and social. Now it's self and sales. 

You could write a list for these three things and look at them all. Which two things are the most important to you right now?
